parent_objective: qualify localizer-labeled comparison candidates before any controller-family ranking
blocked_by: M2013 admits bounded qualification but rejects direct ranking from the single localizer-labeled candidate
supersedes: direct controller-family ranking from M2012 comparison_ready_candidate_count

public_gates: M2014 must implement a no-rerun candidate qualification tool or equivalent deterministic postprocess
M2014 must read only M2012 localization artifacts
M2014 must not reset the environment or execute policy actions
M2014 must separate qualification from ranking
M2014 must write structured admitted and rejected candidate rows
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns M2012 localizer-labeled candidates into explicit admit/reject qualification decisions before ranking
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: candidate qualification only; no controller ranking paper-level or level3 self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if qualification requires new rollout
stop if candidate rules rank controller families
stop if qualification cannot explain admission or rejection reasons
stop if no candidate is admitted and another local repair is proposed without synthesis
fallback_plan: route to bounded comparison design if at least one candidate is admitted
route to targeted task-quality repair or scenario redesign if no candidate is admitted
route to artifact text repair if stale localizer text blocks clean exports
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2013 routes to bounded comparison qualification

admission_evidence: M2013 found one actionable localizer-labeled comparison-ready candidate but rejected direct ranking
allowed_updates: M2014 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit or next route
next_stage_criteria: guardrails show no rollout or ranking

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; candidate qualification does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2014.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no candidate qualifies, do not rank; route to repair/redesign or synthesis.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds explicit comparison-readiness qualification instead of accepting or rejecting a localizer label by narrative
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether bounded controller-family comparison is admissible from M2012 support
must_synthesize_if: only singleton support is admitted and another repair loop is proposed
qualification requires thresholds to be repeatedly changed

hypothesis: A deterministic no-rerun qualification pass can decide whether the M2012 candidate is admissible for bounded comparison design.
success_criteria: the output separates admitted and rejected candidates
no ranking or paper-level claim is made
failure_criteria: environment rollout or policy action execution occurs
controller-family ranking or paper-level claims are made

commands.name: implement_and_run
commands.command: implement focused no-rerun bounded comparison candidate qualification and run it on M2012 artifacts

decision_rule: M2014 passes if it produces no-rerun admit/reject candidate qualification rows with clean guardrails.
